From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Italian

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Latin assignāre and adapted to native segnare.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /as.seɲˈɲa.re/
  • Rhymes: -are
  • Hyphenation: as‧se‧gnà‧re

Verb

[edit]

assegnàre (first-person singular present asségno, first-person singular past historic assegnài, past participle assegnàto, auxiliary avére) (transitive)

  1. to assign, allocate or allot
  2. to award
  3. to sign over
  4. to room
